sentences.en: This has been the trend for the past twenty years.
sentences.zh: 过去二十年来，这就是趋势。

sentences.en: Financial experts don't know what to make of this trend.
sentences.zh: 金融专家对这种趋势感到摸不着头脑。

sentences.en: What is "Tatoeba"? Is it some kind of new trend?
sentences.zh: 什么是‘Tatoeba’？这难道是一种新的流行趋势吗？

mnemonic: 联想记忆：tend（倾向）加r还是倾向（trend）
